scopeStatement: This spec does not create live ingestion.
This spec does not read files.
This spec does not activate automations.
This spec does not add runtime wiring.
This spec does not create a new control plane.
This spec only defines the accepted report contract.
forbiddenCapabilities: execute commands from the Control Panel
read local files live from HTML
fetch files or APIs from HTML
create a second Brain or Cortex

fieldDescriptions.reportId: Stable unique report identifier within the monitor output stream.
fieldDescriptions.monitorId: One of the allowed monitor identifiers.
fieldDescriptions.generatedAt: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp for report generation.
fieldDescriptions.sourceType: Manual paste, saved automation report, human-entered summary, or other approved static source.
fieldDescriptions.sourceRunId: Optional automation run identifier when available.
fieldDescriptions.sourceRunUrl: Optional URL to source run evidence when available.
fieldDescriptions.commitSha: Commit SHA inspected by the monitor when available.

fields.humanDecisionsRequired: Array of decisions that require human review.
fields.nextSafeAction: Single next action that preserves the Control Panel authority boundary.

fields.findingId: Stable finding identifier within the report.
fields.title: Short finding title.
fields.severity: One of the allowed severity values.
fields.description: Finding details without protected data content.
fields.affectedPaths: Array of repo or workspace paths, if relevant and safe to disclose.
fields.proposedWorkOrderId: Optional Work Order identifier proposed by the monitor.
fields.rejectionReason: Required when the finding status is rejected.

fields.evidenceId: Stable evidence identifier referenced by findings.
fields.type: file-path, command-output, run-url, human-note, schema-check, or other static evidence type.
fields.source: Source report, static path, run URL, or human note.
fields.command: Optional command that produced evidence; descriptive only, not executable by the Control Panel.
fields.timestamp: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp for the evidence.

reportOrFindingMustBeRejectedIf: asks the Control Panel to execute commands
asks the Control Panel to activate automations
asks the Control Panel to read local files live
asks the HTML page to fetch files or APIs
creates a second Brain/Cortex or autonomous queue
rejectionRules.p0P1EvidenceRule: P0 and P1 findings require at least one evidenceRef that resolves to an evidence entry.
rejectionRules.protectedDataRule: Use metadata, redacted path references, or synthetic examples only. Do not include protected operational data in report intake examples.

steps: Control Panel prepares a Work Order prompt
separate Work Order authorizes any mutation
report status may be marked converted-to-wo only by human review, not automatically

namingConvention.timestampFormat: UTC basic ISO-8601 without separators, for example 20260623T143000Z
